instructions.read_scope: full document; user-authorized A/B/C scope; embedded evidence checked, no rollback

worktree.head: 88ee557e09e32ee2c7dd11b17309e05a325cb3c2
worktree.integration: isolated latest-remote worktree; original main modifications preserved

environment.cuda_probe: both pallet-pose and pallet-yolo26 torch2.1.1+cu118 CUDA available

initial_state.old_strategy: paper_strategy_master.md 2026-08-28 HISTORICAL; latest20261006 completed receipts take precedence

A.full_reproduction_stage: all;matching completed fits/inference/oracle receipts are reused
A.analysis_reaggregation: finalizing process reaggregates existing per-frame rows under its recorded analysis code;NoOp/corner/oracle-gap/bootstrap descriptor corrections add no optimizer updates

execution_accounting.bank_precompute_seconds: NOT_RECORDED: precompute retries retained valid banks before any optimizer update;fit/oracle/evaluation times have individual receipts
execution_accounting.baseline_evaluation_seconds: NOT_RECORDED: baseline outputs reused or evaluated once,actual F calls counted by rows

generation_code_binding.migration: Add mandatory generation-code guard to first-session bank cache; prior candidate arithmetic unchanged by one-time npz materialization; actual-input affine/NoOp checks passed; NoOp/PERM bank masks unchanged

attempts.reason: Repeated npz member materialization per frame caused excess CPU I/O; all arrays materialized once without changing candidate coordinates or source roles
Before first inference/optimizer, fix artificial NaN-missing backward and keep hard-J selected output in the exact joint bank;source geometry/NoOp/affine unchanged
Reload frozen training modules after installing mandatory generation-code guard and initialization digest receipt;valid numerical-equivalent source banks retained

B.scope: B acquisition packet and bounded reuse checks only

reused_inputs.role: existing dev-session precision context, not B metrology

non_committed_dependencies: model weights/runtime for future acquired frames
third-party source PDFs only kept under /tmp for reading

matched_runtime.precision: FP32 models, frozen feature handoff FP16; matmul TF32 off; original YOLO/N3 cuDNN TF32 on and original PoseFix head cuDNN TF32 off; AMP off
matched_runtime.boundary: native uint8 BGR in RAM -> reflect/letterbox -> shared frozen detector and feature capture -> optional head crop/sampling/decoder -> prediction-only W/D wrapper and final PnP; image decode and model loading excluded
matched_runtime.posefix: purpose-adapted PRIOR1 last6000; uncapped first raw pass, same published accuracy method
matched_runtime.memory_scope: all fixed models resident; process-scoped peaks, not isolated per-method memory

runtime_verification.scope: model identity and existing output parity outside timer, not new accuracy evaluation

A_deployment_runtime.precision: same original YOLO/N3 cuDNN TF32 on; matmul TF32 off; FP32 models/FP16 features; no AMP
A_deployment_runtime.boundary: native BGR RAM image -> preprocessing/detector/features -> prediction-only initial hypotheses and normalized projected motion bank -> fresh feature patch scores and hard J -> actual final W/D plus PnP F(q); no offline oracle candidate-F search

A_runtime_verification.scope: Every timed J action/final W-D/coverage matches locked A evaluation; Base/N3 points match actual cached predictions; comparison outside timer; no extra model inference or optimizer update
